subject: math
description: Construct a line parallel to a given line through a point and verify the result using equal angle or equal distance relationships.
learningObjectives: Identify parallel lines and use correct parallel-line notation
Construct a line parallel to a given line through a point using copied corresponding angles
Use a ruler, set square, or protractor to create an accurate parallel line
Verify a construction by checking equal corresponding angles or equal perpendicular distances
Explain why the constructed line is parallel to the original line
prerequisites: Measure and name angles from diagrams
Construct accurate segments and angles using tools
Recognize perpendicular lines and right angles
Understand corresponding angles from a transversal diagram
